_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: John Durand (1822-1908): Hippolyte Taine's The Origins of Contemporary France (Holt, 1876-94; 6 vols) and The Philosophy of Art, and (added round 101) his Taine from period archive.org scans: Italy: Rome and Naples, Art in the Netherlands and Art in Greece. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 23); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
